content.text: Hi! I'm Lingling. What's your name?
content.translation: 嗨！我是玲玲。你叫什么名字？

content.text: Hello. My name is Amy!
I'm Daming.
I'm Sam.
I'm Bobo.
Goodbye, Bobo. Have a nice day!
content.translation: 再见，波波。祝你度过愉快的一天！

content.text: Good morning! I'm Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好！我是斯玛特老师。

content.text: Good morning, Ms Smart!
Stand up! Sit down! Open your book! Close your book!
content.translation: 起立！坐下！打开书！合上书！

content.text: Point! Say! Read! Listen! Write!
content.translation: 指一指！说一说！读一读！听一听！写一写！

content.text: Hi, everyone! I'm Sam. I'm nine.
content.translation: 大家好！我是萨姆。我九岁。

content.text: She's Amy. She's nine, too.
We're from the UK. We're twins!
content.translation: 我们来自英国。我们是双胞胎！

content.text: Wow!
Hi, Sam. Hi, Amy. I'm Lingling. He's Daming. Come and play!
content.translation: 嗨，萨姆。嗨，艾米。我是玲玲。他是大明。来一起玩吧！

content.text: Good!
We are friends!
Let's be friends!
Oh, no!
Let's help.
Here you are.
Thank you.
Hi, I'm Mia. He's David.
We're nine.
Hi, I'm Ben. I'm nine, too. Let's play together!
content.translation: 嗨，我是本。我也九岁。我们一起玩吧！

content.text: OK!
Great!
Amy! What's this?
It's my schoolbag.
What's this?
It's a book.
What's this?
It's a pen.
Is it a pen, too?
No, it isn't. It's a pencil.
What's this?
It's a ruler.
What's that, Tom?
It's you, Amy!
Bye, kids.
Bye, Ms Olivia.
What's this? Oh, it's a pen.
content.translation: 这是什么？噢，是一支钢笔。

content.text: What's this? It's a ruler.
What's that? It's an eraser.
Is this your pen, Yoyo?
Yes, it is. Thank you.
Is this your ruler, Lulu?
No, it isn't.
It's my eraser.
It's my ruler.
Take care of your school things!
content.translation: 照看好你们的学习用品！

content.text: I want a balloon!
What colour is it? Can you guess?
content.translation: 它是什么颜色？你能猜到吗？

content.text: It's blue!
Yes! Here you are.
I want a balloon, too.
What colour is it?
It's red!
Yes! You are right!
It's yellow!
It's pink!
It's purple!
It's orange!
Bobo! Come back!

Unit 3 It's a colourful world!.unit: Unit 3 It's a colourful world! (Speed up)

content.text: Hello! I'm red.
I'm yellow.
I'm blue.
Let's play together.
Great!
Ha ha!
What colour is it?
It's green.
This is fun!
It's black!
It's orange!
It's purple!
So many colours!
Wow! What is it?
This is a Chinese knot. It's beautiful!
content.translation: 这是一个中国结。它真漂亮！

content.text: Guess! How many ropes?
Six? Twelve?
Ha ha, no.
Look! Only one rope!
That's amazing! How do you make it?
content.translation: 太神奇了！你是怎么编出来的？

content.text: Let me show you.
OK. That's great!
One! Two! Three! Four! Five! Six! Seven! Eight! Nine! Ten! Eleven! Twelve! My twelve eggs!
content.translation: 一！二！三！四！五！六！七！八！九！十！十一！十二！我的十二个蛋！

content.text: Twelve eggs. Twelve babies.
Er, I'm hungry.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven. Oh, no! Only eleven eggs.
content.translation: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十、十一。噢，不！只有十一个蛋。

content.text: My baby!
Cheep! Cheep!
Oh! My babies! Let me count...
content.translation: 噢！我的宝宝们！让我数一数……

content.text: Sam, this is my dad.
Hello.
Hello.
This is my grandpa.
Hello.
Hi.
That is my grandma.
But who is that?
That is my grandma!
Oh, this is my grandma.
I'm Jiajia. This is my sister.
This is my dad. This is my mum. That's my grandma and that's my grandpa.
content.translation: 这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。那是我奶奶，那是我爷爷。

content.text: Look at the cap.
Oh, no! The cap! Come back, Lucky!
Don't worry! We can help!
Grandma, Grandpa, Dad, Mum, come on!
content.translation: 奶奶、爷爷、爸爸、妈妈，加油！

content.text: Great!
Dad, where's Susu?
She's in the living room. On the chair, I think.
content.translation: 她在客厅。我想是在椅子上。

content.text: Susu is not here.
Mum, where's Susu?
Look in the bedroom. She's under the bed.
content.translation: 去卧室看看。她在床底下。

content.text: Susu's toy is here. But where is she?
content.translation: 苏苏的玩具在这里。可她在哪儿呢？

content.text: Miaow...
Susu?
Oh! Susu is in the box with four little babies!
content.translation: 噢！苏苏在盒子里，身边还有四只小宝宝！

content.text: This is my home. A bedroom and a living room.
content.translation: 这是我的家。一间卧室和一个客厅。

content.text: This is my home. A bedroom, a living room and a kitchen.
content.translation: 这是我的家。一间卧室、一个客厅和一个厨房。

content.text: Who are you? You are in my bedroom!
content.translation: 你是谁？你在我的卧室里！

content.text: No, you're in my living room!
Oh, no! Help!
No home for us now!
Look at the apple!
Let's make a new home there... and share it!
content.translation: 我们在那儿建个新家吧……一起住！

content.text: This is our sweet home!
Look at my picture!
Are they tigers?
Yes!
But tigers are strong!
What are they, Tom?
They're elephants.
But elephants are big.
What are they?
They're giraffes.
Oh, Tom. Giraffes aren't short!
Are they pandas?
Yes! They're black and white!
content.translation: 是的！它们是黑白相间的！

content.text: Ha ha! That's not right. Let me help you.
content.translation: 哈哈！那不对。让我来帮你。

content.text: Hi, I'm Tippi. Look! This is my book.
content.translation: 嗨，我是蒂皮。看！这是我的书。

content.text: This is Abu. He is an elephant. He is big and strong. I love him.
content.translation: 这是阿布。他是一头大象。他又大又强壮。我爱他。

content.text: This is Leon. He is a chameleon. He is small.
content.translation: 这是利昂。他是一只变色龙。他很小。

content.text: This is Linda. She is an ostrich. She is fast.
content.translation: 这是琳达。她是一只鸵鸟。她跑得很快。

content.text: This is Mufasa. He is a little lion. He is cute.
content.translation: 这是木法沙。他是一只小狮子。他很可爱。

content.text: They are my animal friends. I love them.
content.translation: 他们是我的动物朋友们。我爱他们。

content.text: Good work, children!
Let's make a snowman!
Look! He has got a red mouth.
Now, he has got a long nose.
content.translation: 现在，他有了一只长鼻子。

content.text: Oh, he hasn't got eyes.
I've got two rocks!
Now he has got two eyes.
He's got long arms and big hands!
content.translation: 他有了长长的胳膊和大大的手！

content.text: Wow! You've got a cool snowman!
content.translation: 哇！你们有一个很酷的雪人！

content.text: I'm the best!
No, I'm the best!
Hello, who is there?
Sorry, Nana. We are your body parts. Who is the best for you?
content.translation: 对不起，娜娜。我们是你的身体部位。谁对你来说是最好的？

content.text: You've got two ears. We help you hear.
content.translation: 你有两只耳朵。我们帮你听声音。

content.text: You've got two eyes. We help you see.
content.translation: 你有两只眼睛。我们帮你看东西。

content.text: I help you smell.
I help you talk and eat.
And me...
And me...
And me...
And me...
Hey! Please stop! You are all important to me. You're a team.
content.translation: 嘿！请停下！你们对我来说都很重要。你们是一个团队。

content.text: You're right! Let's work together for Nana!
content.translation: 你说得对！咱们为了娜娜一起协作吧！

content.text: Welcome! Hello!
Let's make a salad together!
OK. I like tomatoes and oranges.
content.translation: 好的。我喜欢西红柿和橙子。

content.text: I like bananas.
I like beans.
I don't like beans. I like cucumbers.
content.translation: 我不喜欢豆子。我喜欢黄瓜。

content.text: Then let's have cucumbers!
What about Tom? He likes grapes.
Wow! It's a rainbow salad.
Do you like it?
Yes, I do. It's beautiful!
Hello, Grandma. Hello, Grandpa.
Hello, Taotao and Jiajia. Time to get up, children.
content.translation: 涛涛、佳佳，你们好。孩子们，该起床了。

content.text: But it's still early.
Let's get ready for breakfast.
Do you like eggs?
Yes, we do.
Now we've got eggs.
Do you like tomatoes?
Yes, we do.
Now we've got tomatoes.
Do you like corn?
Yes, I do.
Now we've got corn.
Do you like apples?
No, I don't. I like grapes.
content.translation: 不，我不喜欢。我喜欢葡萄。

content.text: OK. Let's get grapes.
Thank you, Grandma and Grandpa.
Yummy!
What are these?
Photos of my family.
Who is this?
That's my dad. He likes running.
content.translation: 那是我爸爸。他喜欢跑步。

content.text: Who is this?
That's my mum. She likes writing.
content.translation: 那是我妈妈。她喜欢写作。

content.text: They are your grandpa and grandma.
Yes, they like doing tai chi.
What do you like doing, Daming?
I like taking photos!
This is Fabre. He likes learning about animals and plants.
content.translation: 这是法布尔。他喜欢研究动植物。

content.text: He likes asking questions. Why? When? What? How many? How? Where?
content.translation: 他喜欢提问。为什么？什么时候？是什么？有多少？怎么样？在哪里？

content.text: He likes watching insects.
One day he goes up a tree to study a mantis. He stays there and watches for a long time.
content.translation: 有一天，他爬上树去研究一只螳螂。他待在那里观察了很久。

content.text: Hey! You! Why are you up there?
I'm here to watch this mantis!
content.translation: 我来这里观察这只螳螂！

content.text: Why?
It's so interesting!
Fabre grows up. He writes many books about insects. People like reading them!
content.translation: 法布尔长大后，写了许多关于昆虫的书。人们喜欢读他的书！

content.text: It's half past six. It's time to get up.
Urgh… Not now.
Come on, Sam! It's time for school!
Not now.
It's time to do your homework, Sam.
What time is it? It's only six o'clock. Not now.
content.translation: 现在几点了？才六点。现在不行。

content.text: It's nine o'clock. Time to go to bed, Sam.
Not now!

Unit 5 What time is it?.unit: Unit 5 What time is it? (Speed up)

content.text: It's six o'clock in the morning. Yuanyuan gets up. Her mum is at work.
content.translation: 早上六点。媛媛起床。她的妈妈在上班。

content.text: It's seven o'clock in the morning. Yuanyuan goes to school. Her mum goes home.
content.translation: 早上七点。媛媛去上学。她的妈妈回家。

content.text: It's half past eight in the morning. Yuanyuan has classes at school. Her mum goes to bed.
content.translation: 早上八点半。媛媛在学校上课。她的妈妈去睡觉。

content.text: It's five o'clock in the afternoon. Yuanyuan goes home. Her mum goes to work.
content.translation: 下午五点。媛媛回家。她的妈妈去上班。

content.text: It's nine o'clock in the evening. Yuanyuan goes to bed. Her mum is at work.
content.translation: 晚上九点。媛媛去睡觉。她的妈妈在上班。

content.text: Only two days! It's Wednesday.
content.translation: 只剩两天了！今天星期三。

content.text: It's Thursday! Only one day!
content.translation: 明天星期四！只剩一天了！

content.text: You're happy! Why?
It's Friday! We have art on Friday. We love art.
content.translation: 星期五了！我们周五有美术课。我们喜欢美术。

content.text: Sorry, everyone. Ms Li is not well today.
content.translation: 抱歉，同学们。李老师今天不舒服。

content.text: Oh... No art today!
Let's do something for Ms Li.
content.translation: 我们为李老师做点什么吧。

content.text: Good idea!
It's Monday. Let's go and visit our old friends this Sunday!
content.translation: 星期一。我们这周日去拜访老朋友吧！

content.text: Great!
It's Tuesday. I want to make some bookmarks for Grandma Guo. She likes reading.
content.translation: 星期二。我想给郭奶奶做些书签。她喜欢读书。

content.text: It's Wednesday. I want to make a stick for Grandpa Liu.
content.translation: 星期三。我想给刘爷爷做一根拐杖。

content.text: It's Thursday. What about a painting for Grandma Zhang?
content.translation: 星期四。给张奶奶画幅画怎么样？

content.text: It's Friday. Dad, I want some tea. It's for Grandpa Ma.
content.translation: 星期五。爸爸，我想要些茶。给马爷爷的。

content.text: It's Saturday. Mum, I want some flowers for Granny Ning.
content.translation: 星期六。妈妈，我想要些花送给宁奶奶。

content.text: Sure.
It's Sunday. Thank you so much, Wenwen!
content.translation: 星期日。太谢谢你了，文文！

content.text: Can you jump high, Daming?
Yes, I can.
Can you run fast, Sam?
Yes, I can.
Can you play ping-pong, Lingling?
Yes, I can.
Can you swim, Daming?
No, I can't. But I can learn.
content.translation: 不，我不会。但是我可以学。

content.text: I can swim now!
Wow! You can swim fast!
This is Terry Fox. He lost one leg because of cancer.
content.translation: 这是特里·福克斯。他因为癌症失去了一条腿。

content.text: He ran across Canada to get money for the people with cancer.
content.translation: 他跑遍加拿大为癌症患者筹钱。

content.text: It's OK to fail. Don't give up!
Never stop! Work hard and try your best!
content.translation: 永不停止！努力工作，尽你最大的努力！

content.text: Dad, may I play outside?
Yes. But can you tidy your room first?
content.translation: 可以。但是你能先整理你的房间吗？

content.text: Bobby, can you help me clean the floor?
content.translation: 波比，你能帮我擦地板吗？

content.text: OK. That's easy.
Go, Bobby! Good job!
Sam, are you still busy?
Yes, Dad. I need to clean the floor, the desk and the wall.
content.translation: 是的，爸爸。我需要擦地板、书桌和墙。

content.text: Bobby, stop! Look! It's so dirty now!
content.translation: 波比，停下！看！现在它好脏啊！

content.text: I'm Yao Qinwen. This is my family. My dad is ill. My grandma is old. My mum is busy. I must help!
content.translation: 我是姚沁文。这是我的家人。我爸爸生病了，奶奶年纪大了，妈妈很忙。我必须帮忙！

content.text: I take care of Dad.
Can I make the bed for you, Dad?
content.translation: 爸爸，我可以帮你铺床吗？

content.text: Thank you, Wenwen.
I take care of Grandma.
Wenwen, can you help clean the room?
content.translation: 文文，你能帮忙打扫房间吗？

content.text: Sometimes Mum feels tired. I take care of her, too.
content.translation: 妈妈有时候很累。我也照顾她。

content.text: May I help you wash the dishes, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，我可以帮你洗碗吗？

content.text: Thank you, my dear.
Wenwen is so helpful. She is the sunshine of our family.
content.translation: 文文真能干。她是家里的阳光。

content.text: I'm happy to warm up my family!
content.translation: 我很开心能给家人带来温暖！

Unit 3 What's the weather like?.unit: Unit 3 What's the weather like? (Start up)

content.text: What's the weather like?
It's sunny and warm. We can go out to play.
content.translation: 晴朗又暖和。我们可以出去玩。

content.text: Oh, it's cool!
It's windy and cloudy. Let's go home!
content.translation: 又刮风又阴天。我们回家吧！

content.text: Oh! It's rainy now. Let's run!
content.translation: 哦！现在下雨了。我们快跑！

content.text: Look! I've got a good idea.
Our umbrellas are great!

Unit 3 What's the weather like?.unit: Unit 3 What's the weather like? (Speed up)

content.text: Liu Fei is a teacher at a children's home in Sanya.
content.translation: 刘菲是三亚一家儿童福利院的老师。

content.text: What is snow like?
Does it taste like ice cream?
Liu Fei calls her friend Lin Jia in Harbin.
content.translation: 刘菲给她在哈尔滨的朋友林佳打电话。

content.text: Hey, what's the weather like there today?
content.translation: 嘿，你那里今天天气怎么样？

content.text: It's snowy and cold.
The children here want to see real snow. But it's hot in Sanya. It never snows.
content.translation: 这里的孩子们想看真正的雪。但是三亚很热，从来不下雪。

content.text: Two days later, Liu Fei gets a big surprise.
content.translation: 两天后，刘菲收到一个大惊喜。

content.text: Liu Fei, here is some snow for the children. I hope they like it! Love, Lin Jia
content.translation: 刘菲，这里有一些雪送给孩子们。希望他们喜欢！林佳

content.text: Liu Fei takes the snow to the children's home.
content.translation: 刘菲把雪带到儿童福利院。

content.text: Look! Real snow!
It's cool!
Hooray!
What's your favourite season, friends?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们最喜欢哪个季节？

content.text: I like winter best. I can play in the snow.
content.translation: 我最喜欢冬天。我可以在雪里玩。

content.text: I don't like winter. It's cold. I like spring and autumn. They are beautiful.
content.translation: 我不喜欢冬天。冬天很冷。我喜欢春天和秋天。它们很美。

content.text: I like summer best. I can eat ice cream. What about you, Lingling?
content.translation: 我最喜欢夏天。我可以吃冰淇淋。玲玲，你呢？

content.text: I like summer best, too.
Why do you also like summer?
Because my birthday is in summer!
Ha ha!
I'm Li Han. This is my apple tree.
content.translation: 我是李涵。这是我的苹果树。

content.text: I'm ten now. The tree is ten, too. Spring is here! The birds are back.
content.translation: 我现在十岁了。这棵树也十岁了。春天来了！鸟儿回来了。

content.text: It's summer. The apple tree is like a sun umbrella. I like reading under it.
content.translation: 夏天到了。苹果树像一把太阳伞。我喜欢在树下读书。

content.text: It's autumn. I like autumn best! There are many red apples on the tree!
content.translation: 秋天到了。我最喜欢秋天！树上有很多红苹果！

content.text: Can I share the apples with my friends? Sure!
content.translation: 我能和朋友们分享这些苹果吗？当然！

content.text: It's winter. My apple tree has warm, new clothes.
content.translation: 冬天到了。我的苹果树穿上了暖和的新衣服。

content.text: A snowstorm comes. Oh, no! My apple tree! I don't like winter!
content.translation: 暴风雪来了。哦，不！我的苹果树！我不喜欢冬天！

content.text: Don't worry. Let's wait for spring.
content.translation: 别担心。让我们等待春天。

content.text: It's spring again. My apple tree grows again. Hooray!
content.translation: 春天又来了。我的苹果树又生长了。万岁！

content.text: Let's go for a picnic in the park.
Hooray!
How do we get there?
Let's go by car! It's fast!
No, let's go in a "green" way!
content.translation: 不，让我们用“绿色”的方式去！

content.text: A green way?
Yes. Go and get ready. Let's meet in five minutes.
content.translation: 是的。去准备吧。我们五分钟后见。

content.text: We're green now! Let's go!
content.translation: 我们现在是绿色的了！出发！

content.text: Ha ha! Not that kind of green!
This kind of green!
Hello, I'm Jingjing. This is my friend Sihai. We live in Sichuan.
content.translation: 你好，我是晶晶。这是我的朋友四海。我们住在四川。

content.text: It's time to go to Qatar! But how do we get there? It's far away.
content.translation: 该去卡塔尔了！但是我们怎么去呢？那里很远。

content.text: Look! The truck is here. Let's go! Goodbye, everyone!
content.translation: 看！卡车来了。我们走吧！再见，大家！

content.text: Now we are on a plane in the sky. Goodbye, China!
content.translation: 现在我们在天上的飞机里。再见，中国！

content.text: What a long way! Here we are! Hello, Qatar! We go to our new home by truck.
content.translation: 好远的路啊！我们到了！你好，卡塔尔！我们坐卡车去我们的新家。

content.text: It's our new home. It's big. We've got a lot of bamboo here. It comes from China by plane!
content.translation: 这是我们的新家。它很大。我们这里有很多竹子。它们是从中国空运来的！

content.text: Many people come to see us. We've got a lot of new friends! We are happy!
content.translation: 很多人来看我们。我们交了很多新朋友！我们很开心！

content.text: My cat Susu goes out every morning! Where does she go?
content.translation: 我的猫苏苏每天早上都出去！她去哪儿？

content.text: Where does she go? I don't know! Let's find out tomorrow.
content.translation: 她去哪儿？我不知道！我们明天去查个明白。

content.text: Susu goes straight on to the museum. She turns left there.
content.translation: 苏苏直着走到博物馆。她在那里左转。

content.text: At the hospital, she turns right.
Then Susu stops. Let's go there!
content.translation: 然后苏苏停下了。我们去那儿吧！

content.text: Go straight on to the museum. Then turn left.
content.translation: 直着走到博物馆。然后左转。

content.text: Turn right at the hospital.
Yanyan can't see. She goes to school with her mum's help every day.
content.translation: 燕燕看不见。她每天在妈妈的帮助下上学。

content.text: Mum, I'm 11 now. I want to go to school on my own!
content.translation: 妈妈，我现在 11 岁了。我想自己去上学！

content.text: Remember, go straight on, walk 50 steps... 48, 49, 50! Great! Cross the road. Turn left. The school is on your right.
content.translation: 记住，一直往前走，走 50 步……48、49、50！太好了！过马路，向左转。学校在你的右边。

content.text: Mum, let me go to school on my own today!
content.translation: 妈妈，今天让我自己去上学吧！

content.text: Are you sure?
Yes, I can do it.
One, two, three...
Be careful, my girl!
Go straight on... 48, 49, 50! OK. Cross the road and turn left.
content.translation: 一直往前走……48、49、50！好。过马路，向左转。

content.text: I'm at school now, Mum!
Well done, Yanyan!
Who's the man?
This is my father.
What does he do? Have a guess!
Is he a farmer?
No, he isn't. But he often works in the fields.
content.translation: 不，他不是。但他经常在田里工作。

content.text: Is he a painter?
No, he isn't. But he uses his brush a lot.
content.translation: 不，他不是。但他经常用画笔。

content.text: I know! He's a scientist!
That's right!
Oh, look at this!
Oh, a night owl!
Yes, I come out at night. But many people are "night owls", too. Do you know that?
content.translation: 是的，我晚上出来。但很多人也是“夜猫子”，你知道吗？

content.text: Bus drivers and taxi drivers work at night. They take people home.
content.translation: 公交车司机和出租车司机上夜班。他们送人们回家。

content.text: Police officers and firemen work at night, too. They keep the city safe.
content.translation: 警察和消防员也在夜间工作。他们守护着城市的安全。

content.text: Doctors and nurses are busy at night. They help people.
content.translation: 医生和护士晚上很忙。他们帮助别人。

content.text: So many people work at night. They brighten the night for others.
content.translation: 这么多人在夜间工作。他们为别人照亮了夜晚。

content.text: I work at night, too. Time to go!
content.translation: 我也在夜间工作。该走了！

Unit 2 How do you feel today.unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today (Start up)

content.text: It's my first Beijing opera show with Lingling. I'm so excited.
content.translation: 这是我和玲玲第一次参加京剧表演。我太兴奋了。

content.text: Lingling, it's Amy's mum. Amy is ill today.
content.translation: 玲玲，是艾米的妈妈。艾米今天病了。

content.text: Is she coughing?
Yes, she is. She can't talk.
She can't take part in the show today. She's sad.
content.translation: 她今天不能参加演出了。她很难过。

content.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
Dear Amy, Get well soon. Don't be sad. We can do it next time.
content.translation: 亲爱的艾米，早日康复。别难过。我们下次再表演。

content.text: Dear Lingling, Thank you. I'm feeling better now.
content.translation: 亲爱的玲玲，谢谢你。我现在好多了。

content.text: Time for the show. I'm happy!
content.translation: 演出时间到了。我很开心！

Unit 2 How do you feel today.unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today (Speed up)

content.text: Jay gets a new ship model for his birthday. He is very surprised and happy.
content.translation: 杰伊生日收到一艘新的船模型。他又惊又喜。

content.text: It's the new ship model! Thank you!
It's nine o'clock. Time for bed, Jay.
I'm making the ship.
You can make it tomorrow.
Bang!
Ray! My ship!
Jay, I am...
Jay is angry. He is shouting at Ray.
content.translation: 杰伊很生气。他对雷大喊。

content.text: Jay runs back to his room. He is sad.
content.translation: 杰伊跑回自己的房间。他很难过。

content.text: I'm sorry.
Jay says sorry, too. They make the ship together. They are happy now.
content.translation: 杰伊也说了对不起。他们一起重做船。现在他们很开心。

content.text: What are you looking at?
I'm looking at their clothes.
Are you worried?
Yes. Everyone's wearing beautiful clothes. But I'm not. I can't win.
content.translation: 是的。每个人都穿着漂亮的衣服，可我没有。我赢不了。

content.text: Don't worry about your clothes. Just go and dance.
content.translation: 别担心你的衣服。去跳舞就好。

content.text: OK.
You can do this, Lingling!
Thanks!
She's dancing well.
The best dancer is... Lingling!
Hooray!
Look at me!
She's flying so well! Oh, Bird, please teach me to fly.
content.translation: 她飞得真好！小鸟，请教我飞吧。

content.text: Oh, no. I'm not good at flying.
Look at me!
He's running so well. Oh, Dog, please teach me to run.
content.translation: 他跑得真快。小狗，请教我跑吧。

content.text: Oh, no. I'm not good at running.
Look at me!
He's swimming so well! Oh, Duck, please teach me to swim.
content.translation: 他游得真好！鸭子，请教我游泳吧。

content.text: Oh, no. I'm not good at swimming.
Why are you crying, my boy?
Cock-a-doodle-doo. I'm not good at anything.
content.translation: 喔喔喔。我什么都不擅长。

content.text: Don't worry. Let me teach you to sing.
Listen! Little Chicken is singing. He sings so well!
content.translation: 听！小鸡在唱歌。他唱得真好！

content.text: See? That's your talent.
What are you doing?
We're digging.
For what?
We're making a small garden for the class!
content.translation: 我们在为班级建一个小花园！

content.text: I've got tomato seeds.
I've got bean seeds.
I've got cucumber seeds.
I've got sunflower seeds.
Two weeks later.
Are your seeds growing?
Yes, they are. Look!
Are your seeds growing, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，你的种子发芽了吗？

content.text: Why aren't my seeds growing?
content.translation: 为什么我的种子不发芽？

content.text: Oh, Sam. These seeds can't grow!
content.translation: 哦，萨姆。这些种子不能发芽！

content.text: Why?
Because your seeds are from a snack bag.
content.translation: 因为你的种子是从零食袋里来的。

content.text: Let me plant a new one.
I'm Huahua. This is my grandpa. He's a scientist.
content.translation: 我是花花。这是我的爷爷。他是一位科学家。

content.text: I like staying with Grandpa. He's reading and I'm sleeping.
content.translation: 我喜欢和爷爷待在一起。他看书，我睡觉。

content.text: Grandpa often works in the fields. I like playing with the rice plants there.
content.translation: 爷爷经常在田里工作。我喜欢在那儿和水稻玩。

content.text: Look, Grandpa! I've got a mouse!
content.translation: 看，爷爷！我抓到一只老鼠！

content.text: Grandpa works hard. Sometimes I work, too!
content.translation: 爷爷工作很努力。有时我也工作！

content.text: Grandpa has two dreams. He wants to grow tall rice plants, with big grains. He can sit under them. He also wants to feed the world with his rice.
content.translation: 爷爷有两个梦想。他想种出高大、谷粒饱满的水稻，能在稻下乘凉。他还想用自己的水稻养活全世界。

content.text: I miss Grandpa. I think his dreams will come true!
content.translation: 我想念爷爷。我相信他的梦想会实现！

content.text: These are my works for the Art Festival.
content.translation: 这些是我为艺术节准备的作品。

content.text: Look! That's a cow. There are horns on it.
content.translation: 看！那是一头牛。上面有角。

content.text: That's rain. Those are raindrops.
Are you drawing?
No, I'm writing Chinese words.
Are there more?
Yes, there are.
Weiwei and Lanlan are on a field trip.
content.translation: 薇薇和兰兰在参加户外研学。

content.text: Look! A baby bird!
It falls off the tree. Can we help it?
content.translation: 它从树上掉下来了。我们能帮它吗？

content.text: Yes, we can. Let's call the forest keeper!
content.translation: 能。我们给护林员打电话吧！

content.text: The forest keeper comes.
The baby bird is home. Thank you, children.
content.translation: 小鸟回家了。谢谢你们，孩子们。

content.text: Hey, look! The mother bird is back.
How lovely! They are a happy family!
content.translation: 真可爱！它们是幸福的一家！

content.text: This is a very special field trip for us!
content.translation: 这对我们来说是一次很特别的研学！

content.text: Lingling, what do you want to wear to the party?
content.translation: 玲玲，你想穿什么去聚会？

content.text: My favourite blue dress!
content.translation: 我最喜欢的蓝色连衣裙！

content.text: Oh, that dress is nice!
What are you doing, Lingling?
I'm looking for my blue dress.
content.translation: 我在找我的蓝色连衣裙。

content.text: Oh, it's small for me now.
Mum, are you cutting up my dress?
content.translation: 妈妈，你在剪我的裙子吗？

content.text: Don't worry. I have an idea.
The next day.
Lingling, you're not wearing that blue dress.
content.translation: 玲玲，你没穿那条蓝色连衣裙。

content.text: Yes, I'm wearing it!
Tom makes clothes for animals. He's busy every day!
content.translation: 汤姆为动物们做衣服。他每天都很忙！

content.text: We need clothes for a Christmas party!
content.translation: 我们需要圣诞聚会的衣服！

content.text: OK!
Lovely dresses and hats! Nice shirts!
content.translation: 好看的裙子和帽子！漂亮的衬衫！

content.text: My family want colourful shirts!
content.translation: 我的家人想要色彩鲜艳的衬衫！

content.text: I have eight brothers and sisters. We all look the same! Dad gets our names wrong. Can you help?
content.translation: 我有八个兄弟姐妹。我们长得都一样！爸爸总是叫错我们的名字。你能帮忙吗？

content.text: No problem!
Now we're wearing T-shirts with our names.
content.translation: 现在我们穿着印着自己名字的 T 恤。

content.text: Clever idea!
Here comes Mr Bird. He wants something special.
content.translation: 小鸟先生来了。他想要点特别的东西。

content.text: A birthday present for Ms Whale? Let me think.
content.translation: 给鲸鱼女士的生日礼物？让我想想。

content.text: The next day, Tom asks all the animals to come and help.
content.translation: 第二天，汤姆请所有动物来帮忙。

Unit 1 What's on your plate?.unit: Unit 1 What's on your plate? (Start up)

content.text: Wow! There is so much food.
What do you want to eat?
I want noodles in soup, salad and beef.
content.translation: 我想要汤面、沙拉和牛肉。

content.text: I want chicken and beef.
I want an apple and milk, too!
content.translation: 我还想要一个苹果和牛奶！

content.text: I like cake and cola.
Don't take too much! We should eat all the food on our plates.
content.translation: 不要拿太多！我们应该把盘子里的食物都吃完。

content.text: Sam, look at your plate. You should have some vegetables.
content.translation: 萨姆，看看你的盘子。你应该吃点蔬菜。

content.text: OK. Let me go and get some.
What vegetables have you got now?
Potatoes, a lot of potatoes.
Oh, Sam!!! Those are chips!

Unit 1 What's on your plate?.unit: Unit 1 What's on your plate? (Speed up)

content.text: Dear Sally, That's enough! This is a bad day for me again!
content.translation: 亲爱的萨莉，够了！今天对我来说又是糟糕的一天！

content.text: Every morning, you need a good breakfast. Let's have bread, milk, eggs, fruit and vegetables. Just a few biscuits are not enough! I often feel hungry all morning.
content.translation: 每天早上，你都需要一顿丰盛的早餐。让我们吃些面包、牛奶、鸡蛋、水果和蔬菜吧。只吃几块饼干是不够的！我经常整个上午都觉得饿。

content.text: Then you often eat too much for lunch. You have a lot of meat, but no vegetables and no fruit. I get too heavy. This makes you sleepy in the afternoon.
content.translation: 然后你午饭又经常吃得太多。你吃很多肉，却没有蔬菜和水果。我变得太沉重了。这让你下午犯困。

content.text: And you always eat dinner too fast so you can go and play. You should eat slowly. I have to work hard for a long time after dinner. I'm so tired.
content.translation: 而且你晚餐总是吃得太快，好去玩。你应该慢慢吃。晚饭后我不得不辛苦工作很长时间。我太累了。

content.text: Sally, please make some changes. Help me stay healthy. Then you are healthy, too.
content.translation: 萨莉，请做些改变。帮我保持健康，这样你也会健康。

content.text: With love, Your stomach
The dress is too small for you, Amy.
content.translation: 艾米，这条裙子对你来说太小了。

content.text: Mum, don't throw it away. I can make use of it.
content.translation: 妈妈，别扔掉它。我可以利用它。

content.text: OK. Take it. But what for?
content.translation: 好的，拿去吧。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
Grandpa, give those cans to me, please.
content.translation: 爷爷，请把那些罐子给我。

content.text: Sure, but what for?
content.translation: 当然可以，但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
Don't throw away that box, Dad! I want to use it.
content.translation: 爸爸，别扔掉那个盒子！我想用它。

content.text: OK, you can keep it. But what for?
content.translation: 好的，你可以留着。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
Grandma, give that old shirt to me, please.
No problem. But what for?
content.translation: 没问题。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
These are houses for birds. They're also places to keep them warm.
content.translation: 这些是鸟的房子。它们也是给鸟儿保暖的地方。

content.text: I love it! Now they have a better home!
content.translation: 我太喜欢了！现在它们有了更好的家！

content.text: Dear all,
Each of us has a box of milk every day at school. We use over 150,000 milk boxes every year! But many of us just throw them away.
content.translation: 在学校，我们每人每天都会喝一盒牛奶。每年我们要用掉超过 15 万个牛奶盒！但很多人直接把它们扔掉了。

content.text: Milk boxes have three parts: paper, plastic and metal. Each part can turn into something new, like newspapers, bottles and cans.
content.translation: 牛奶盒有三个部分：纸、塑料和金属。每一部分都能变成新东西，比如报纸、瓶子和罐子。

content.text: It is easy to recycle a milk box in just three steps: 1. Open the milk box and wash it with water. 2. Make it flat. 3. Put it into a recycling box.
content.translation: 回收一个牛奶盒很简单，只需三步：1. 拆开牛奶盒，用水洗净。2. 把它压平。3. 放进回收箱。

content.text: Now the milk box moves to a new beginning! Let's start now for a green world!
content.translation: 现在这个牛奶盒走向新的开始！让我们为了绿色的世界立刻行动！

content.text: Students from Class 502
For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and only friend.
content.translation: 对多多来说，图图是他最好、也是唯一的朋友。

content.text: He wants to play with Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two other boys.
content.translation: 他想和图图一起玩，但图图正和另外两个男孩玩。

content.text: This makes Duoduo unhappy.
Tutu asks Duoduo to join them but Duoduo just walks away.
content.translation: 图图叫多多一起玩，但多多只是走开了。

content.text: After a week, Duoduo feels sad and he misses Tutu.
content.translation: 一周后，多多感到难过，他很想念图图。

content.text: But Tutu may not miss me because he has new friends.
content.translation: 但是图图可能不想我，因为他有了新朋友。

content.text: Hi Duoduo. How are you?
I'm unhappy because I'm not your friend now.
content.translation: 我不开心，因为我现在不是你的朋友了。

content.text: Yes, I have new friends, but you're still my friend.
content.translation: 是的，我有新朋友，但你仍然是我的朋友。

content.text: Old friends and new friends are both very nice. Join us and they can be your friends, too.
content.translation: 老朋友和新朋友都很好。加入我们吧，他们也会成为你的朋友。

content.text: Now Duoduo has three best friends!
content.translation: 现在多多有了三个最好的朋友！

content.text: You can't be friends with Dog because you're so different.
content.translation: 你不能和狗狗做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

content.text: You can't be friends with Bird because you're so different.
content.translation: 你不能和小鸟做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

content.text: Let's show them we aren't different. Then we can be friends.
content.translation: 让我们证明我们并没有不同。那样我们就能做朋友了。

content.text: Good idea!
I am small and you are big. I eat seeds and you eat meat. I fly and you run.
content.translation: 我小你大。我吃种子你吃肉。我飞你跑。

content.text: Er, what do we share?
We want to be friends but we can't. We are so different.
content.translation: 我们想成为朋友，但做不到。我们太不一样了。

content.text: But we are friends because we are happy together.
content.translation: 但我们能成为朋友，因为我们在一起很开心。

content.text: Friends play together and friends share with each other. That's the key.
content.translation: 朋友一起玩耍，朋友互相分享。这才是关键。

content.text: Let's show this to our parents. Then we can be friends — the best friends!
content.translation: 让我们把这一点展示给我们的父母。那样我们就能成为朋友——最好的朋友！

content.text: Thursday 11 October
Our school's going to have a girls' basketball team. Amy and I want to join. We're going to have the test tomorrow.
content.translation: 我们学校要组建一支女子篮球队。我和艾米想加入。我们明天要参加选拔。

content.text: Friday 12 October
Amy is in. But I am out. I am very sad.
content.translation: 艾米入选了。但我落选了。我非常难过。

content.text: Sunday 14 October
Amy is so kind. She comes to play basketball with me. I'm going to work hard. I can make it next time.
content.translation: 艾米真好。她来和我一起打篮球。我要努力。下次我一定能成功。

content.text: Friday 26 October
There's going to be a test again. I'm still not sure. But I'm going to try again.
content.translation: 又要选拔了。我仍然没有把握。但我要再试一次。

content.text: Sunday 28 October
I'm in! I'm so happy. I'm going to play with Amy and my other friends!
content.translation: 我入选了！我好开心。我要和艾米以及其他朋友一起打球了！

content.text: My mornings are always busy. My father is ill, but my family has little money. So before school, I have to sell things. With the money, I go to buy medicine for my father.
content.translation: 我的早晨总是很忙。爸爸病了，家里钱很少。所以上学前我得去卖东西。用这些钱，我去给爸爸买药。

content.text: It's a long way, and sometimes there are a lot of people. This morning, there are too many people. I'm worried.
content.translation: 路很远，有时人很多。今天早上人太多，我很着急。

content.text: I hurry to school, but I'm still late. I run into the classroom and my teacher is there. He is unhappy with me.
content.translation: 我赶快去学校，可还是迟到了。我跑进教室，老师在。他对我很不满意。

content.text: Don't be late again.
I feel sad. I sit at my desk and cut a word into it. I'm not going to be late again.
content.translation: 我很难过。我坐在书桌前，在桌面上刻了一个字。我再也不会迟到了。

content.text: The boy is Lu Xun. The word is "早".
content.translation: 这个男孩就是鲁迅。他刻的字是“早”。

Unit 5 Look into the future.unit: Unit 5 Look into the future (Start up)

content.text: What is Dad making?
I am making a robot. I still need some time to get it to work. It will help people a lot.
content.translation: 我在做一个机器人。我还需要一些时间让它运转起来。它会帮人们很多忙。

content.text: What will it do for people?
A lot of things.
Will it do our chores?
Yes, it will. We will have more free time.
content.translation: 是的，会的。我们会有更多空闲时间。

content.text: Great. Will it take care of pets?
content.translation: 太好了。它会照顾宠物吗？

content.text: Yes, it will. It will keep an eye on the pets all day.
content.translation: 是的，会的。它会整天照看宠物。

content.text: Will it play with us?
Yes, it will know all kinds of games and sports.
content.translation: 会的，它懂各种游戏和运动。

content.text: Then we'll have a lot of fun. Well... will it do my homework?
content.translation: 那我们会玩得很开心。嗯……它会做我的作业吗？

content.text: No, it won't!

Unit 5 Look into the future.unit: Unit 5 Look into the future (Speed up)

content.text: Where will people live in the future?
People will live on the moon.
We will travel to Mars in 2080.
The city will be under the sea.
The future of our city is bright.
content.translation: 我们城市的未来是光明的。

content.text: We will use 3-D printing to make food.
content.translation: 我们会用3D打印来做食物。

content.text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Let's make mooncakes for the animals at the zoo!
content.translation: 中秋节要来了。我们给动物园的动物做月饼吧！

content.text: OK! Great idea!
Hello, children! What are you going to make?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们好！你们打算做什么？

content.text: I'm going to make meat mooncakes for the tigers.
content.translation: 我要给老虎做肉馅月饼。

content.text: I'm going to make bamboo mooncakes for the pandas.
content.translation: 我要给熊猫做竹子馅月饼。

content.text: How about you, Amy?
I'm going to make carrot mooncakes for the rabbits.
content.translation: 我要给兔子做胡萝卜馅月饼。

content.text: Are you going to make flower mooncakes for the giraffes?
content.translation: 你要给长颈鹿做花馅月饼吗？

content.text: They won't eat meat mooncakes. They will be very big!
content.translation: 它们不吃肉馅月饼。月饼会很大的！

content.text: What do you do at the Spring Festival?
We eat dumplings and visit our relatives.
What do you do at the Dragon Boat Festival?
People will have dragon boat races.
What do you do at the Lantern Festival?
We put up lanterns and watch the lion dance.
I'm Yangyang. This is my little brother Chenchen.
content.translation: 我是阳阳。这是我的小弟弟晨晨。

content.text: I was four and Chenchen was ten months old. He cried a lot and I was not happy. But I still loved him.
content.translation: 我四岁的时候，晨晨十个月大。他经常哭，我不太开心。但我仍然爱他。

content.text: I was six and Chenchen was three. He didn't listen to me and I was angry. But I still loved him.
content.translation: 我六岁的时候，晨晨三岁。他不听我的话，我很生气。但我仍然爱他。

content.text: I was eight and Chenchen was five. We could play football together. He was not a good player, but we were happy.
content.translation: 我八岁的时候，晨晨五岁。我们可以一起踢足球。他踢得不算好，但我们很开心。

content.text: I'm ten now and Chenchen is seven. We go to the same school and we help each other. It's great to grow up together!
content.translation: 我现在十岁，晨晨七岁。我们在同一所学校上学，互相帮助。一起长大真好！

content.text: The summer camp is over. The past seven days were hard but great.
content.translation: 夏令营结束了。过去的七天很辛苦，但是很棒。

content.text: It was very hot and our training was hard. We walked and ran for hours.
content.translation: 天气很热，我们的训练很艰苦。我们走了好几个小时，也跑了好几个小时。

content.text: I was very tired on the first day. But my teacher and friends were kind and helpful.
content.translation: 第一天我特别累。但是老师和同学们都很友善，乐于帮忙。

content.text: After the first day, I was much better.
content.translation: 第一天之后，我就好多了。

content.text: We also did many other things. On the third day, we cooked lunch on our own.
content.translation: 我们还做了很多别的事情。第三天，我们自己做了午饭。

content.text: We were not good at cooking, but we had a good time together.
content.translation: 我们并不擅长做饭，但是大家一起玩得很开心。

content.text: What was the best dish? It was my “tomatoes with sugar”!
content.translation: 最好吃的菜是什么？是我的“糖拌西红柿”！

content.text: After the camp, we felt great. It was the feeling of growing up.
content.translation: 夏令营结束后，我们感觉棒极了。这就是成长的感觉。

Unit 2 You can make a difference.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference (Start up)

content.text: The four friends went to a hill.
content.translation: 四个好朋友来到一座小山。

content.text: Let’s see who gets to the top first! One, two, three. Run!
content.translation: 我们看看谁最先到达山顶！一、二、三，跑！

content.text: They all hurried up to the top of the hill. At first, Daming was at the front. But then he slowed down. One by one, his friends went past him.
content.translation: 他们都急忙向山顶跑去。起初，大明跑在最前面。但后来他放慢了速度，朋友们一个接一个超过了他。

content.text: I win!
But where's Daming?
They waited and waited. At last, Daming came with a big bag.
content.translation: 他们等啊等。最后，大明拎着一个大袋子来了。

content.text: Where did you go?
I saw some rubbish on the way. I picked it up.
content.translation: 我在路上看到一些垃圾，就把它们捡起来了。

content.text: Daming, you're the real winner!
content.translation: 大明，你才是真正的赢家！

Unit 2 You can make a difference.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference (Speed up)

content.text: The little dog we have is the cutest in the world. Small and playful, he's always by my side.
content.translation: 我们的小狗是世界上最可爱的。它小巧又顽皮，总是陪在我身边。

content.text: “Play with me and love me. I want you with me always.”
content.translation: “和我玩吧，爱我吧。我希望你永远陪着我。”

content.text: But we can't have him for long. He'll be someone's eyes one day.
content.translation: 但我们不能长久地养着他。有一天，他会成为别人的眼睛。

content.text: I made a new friend. He was eighty years old, and he had no family.
content.translation: 我交了一个新朋友。他八十岁了，没有家人。

content.text: He owned a ukulele. So I brought over my guitar. Together the two of us played.
content.translation: 他有一把尤克里里。于是我把我的吉他带了过去。我们两个人一起弹奏。

content.text: We're not good enough for a show. But we didn't sound too bad at all.
content.translation: 我们弹得不够好，没法上台表演。但我们的琴声一点也不难听。

content.text: At lunchtime, I saw the new kid. She sat on her own. She had only the words of a book for her lunch.
content.translation: 午饭时，我看见了那个新来的同学。她独自坐着，午餐只有书里的文字。

content.text: I gave her half of my sandwich. And I had only half for me. But after I ate it, I felt full.
content.translation: 我把三明治的一半给了她，自己只留了一半。但吃完之后，我心里满满的。

content.text: It's library day again! I'm excited! But it keeps raining and raining.
content.translation: 又是图书馆开放日啦！我很激动！可是雨一直下个不停。

content.text: Mum, will the “horse library” come today?
content.translation: 妈妈，“马背图书馆”今天还会来吗？

content.text: Don’t worry. It comes every week, rain or sun.
content.translation: 别担心，它每周都会来，风雨无阻。

content.text: Did you also have library day in the past, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，你们以前也有图书馆开放日吗？

content.text: Yes, we did. But our library only came one time a month.
content.translation: 有的。但是以前图书馆一个月才来一次。

content.text: Were there many books?
No, there weren't. It was a small library.
content.translation: 不多，那是一个小小的图书馆。

content.text: Did you like it?
Yes. Books made me happy. Now I can see the “horse library”. Oh, yes. It’s here!
content.translation: 喜欢。书带给我快乐。看，马背图书馆来啦！哇，真的来了！

content.text: I'm so happy. The library brings not only books but also hope.
content.translation: 我特别开心。这个图书馆带来的不只是书籍，还有希望。

content.text: Book report: The Secret Garden. Title: The Secret Garden. Writer: Frances Hodgson Burnett.
content.translation: 读书报告：《秘密花园》。书名：《秘密花园》。作者：弗朗西斯·霍奇森·伯内特。

content.text: Mary was a 10-year-old girl. She lost her parents and had to live with her uncle. But her uncle was often away. Her cousin Colin was ill in bed.
content.translation: 玛丽是一个十岁的女孩。她失去了父母，不得不和舅舅一起生活。但舅舅经常不在家，表哥科林卧病在床。

content.text: Mary didn't care about others and was often angry. She was unhappy in the new place.
content.translation: 玛丽不关心别人，经常发脾气，在新地方过得不开心。

content.text: One day she found an old garden. There she met a new friend. His name was Dickon. They worked together to bring the garden back to life.
content.translation: 有一天，她发现了一座老旧的花园。在那里她认识了新朋友迪肯。他们一起努力，让花园重焕生机。

content.text: Mary slowly became friendly and kind. She also helped Colin to get well.
content.translation: 玛丽慢慢变得友善温和，她还帮助科林恢复了健康。

content.text: Do you like this book? Yes, I do. I give the book 9 out of 10. It’s a great book about friends, love and nature.
content.translation: 你喜欢这本书吗？是的，我喜欢。我给这本书打 9 分（满分 10 分）。这是一本关于友谊、爱和大自然的好书。

content.text: What is your favourite part of the book? I love the words about flowers and trees in the book. They are beautiful.
content.translation: 你最喜欢书中的哪个部分？我喜欢书中描写花草树木的段落，写得很美。

content.text: I went to the National Museum of China yesterday. I saw an ancient dumpling from Xinjiang! It looks just like dumplings today.
content.translation: 我昨天去了中国国家博物馆。我看到了一个来自新疆的古代饺子！它看起来就和今天的饺子一样。

content.text: What did ancient people put in it? No one knows for sure.
content.translation: 古代人在里面放了什么？没人确切知道。

content.text: The dumpling is from the Tang Dynasty. What does this mean? People ate dumplings over 1,000 years ago!
content.translation: 这个饺子来自唐朝。这意味着什么呢？一千多年前人们就吃饺子了！

content.text: But how did dumplings come to Xinjiang? At that time, Xinjiang was an important place in China.
content.translation: 但是饺子是怎么传到新疆的呢？当时，新疆是中国的一个重要地方。

content.text: People in central China went there by the ancient Silk Road. They brought dumplings to Xinjiang.
content.translation: 中原的人们沿着古丝绸之路去那里，把饺子带到了新疆。

content.text: People ate dumplings so long ago! How interesting!
content.translation: 那么久以前人们就吃饺子了！多么有趣啊！

content.text: Wednesday, 7 February. Watches are so expensive. Most people don’t have one. This morning, I bought my very first watch. From now on, I will always know the time!
content.translation: 2月7日，星期三。手表太贵了，大多数人都没有。今天早上，我买了我的第一块手表。从现在起，我随时都能知道时间了！

content.text: Friday, 16 March. Yesterday, I bought a pair of glasses. I put them on, then I took a boat to work. And I could see all the ships on the River Thames! The river was busy.
content.translation: 3月16日，星期五。昨天我买了一副眼镜。我戴上它，然后乘船去上班。我能看到泰晤士河上的所有船只！这条河很繁忙。

content.text: Sunday, 2 September. A great fire started in London this morning! The fire is now growing very quickly. People are pulling down houses in front of the fire to stop it. But it’s still moving very fast.
content.translation: 9月2日，星期日。今天早上伦敦发生了一场大火！火势现在蔓延得非常快。人们正在火头前面推倒房屋，想阻止火势。但它仍然蔓延得很快。

content.text: Monday, 3 September. I dug a hole in my garden. I put some cheese from Italy into it! It’s expensive. I hope it is safe from the fire.
content.translation: 9月3日，星期一。我在花园里挖了一个洞，把一些意大利奶酪放了进去！它很贵。我希望它能免受火灾。

content.text: On Monday
What are you doing, Mum?
I'm looking for my ring. I can't find it.
content.translation: 我在找我的戒指。我找不到它了。

content.text: Where did you put it?
I put it on the desk this morning.
content.translation: 我今天早上把它放在桌子上了。

content.text: On Wednesday
Are you ready to go, Dad?
content.translation: 爸爸，您准备好出发了吗？

content.text: No, I can't find my car key.
content.translation: 没有，我找不到我的车钥匙了。

content.text: Where was it?
It was on the desk.
On Friday
Daming, are you OK?
I can't find my coins. Did you see them?
content.translation: 我找不到我的硬币了。您看到它们了吗？

content.text: No, I didn't.
First, Mum's ring. Then, Dad's key. Now, my coins. What's going on?
content.translation: 先是妈妈的戒指，然后爸爸的钥匙，现在是我的硬币。这是怎么回事？

content.text: I know. Come over here, everyone!
content.translation: 我知道了。大家到这儿来！

content.text: What for?
Look! The lost things are all there.
content.translation: 看！丢失的东西都在那里。

content.text: Well done, Daming!
Detective Sharp came to the prison. The police showed him a letter from Jim Burton.
content.translation: 夏普侦探来到监狱。警察给他看了一封吉姆·伯顿写的信。

content.text: What did he do?
He stole many jewels. But we didn't find the jewels on him.
content.translation: 他偷了很多珠宝。但我们在他身上没有找到珠宝。

content.text: Let's see the letter.
Dear Susan, I hope you’re happy after reading these sweet words!
content.translation: 亲爱的苏珊：我希望你读完这些甜言蜜语后能开心！

content.text: I miss you and our girls, my sweet. There is so much to say. You are all so sweet. Are you happy these days? Your eyes are bright and sweet. Jewels can’t be so shiny. You look sweet in your green dress! You always look so sweet! The girls look happy in our sweet garden. Love, Jim
content.translation: 我想你和我们的女儿们，我的宝贝。有太多话想说。你们都那么甜美。这些天你开心吗？你的眼睛明亮又甜美。珠宝都没这么闪亮。你穿绿色连衣裙看起来很甜美！你总是那么甜美！女儿们在我们甜蜜的花园里看起来很开心。爱你的，吉姆

content.text: There is something wrong with the letter. But I just don't know what it is.
content.translation: 这封信有点问题。但我就是不知道问题在哪儿。

content.text: Aha, I see! Don’t give the letter to his wife. We can get the jewels back now!
content.translation: 啊哈，我明白了！别把这封信交给他的妻子。我们现在就能把珠宝找回来！

content.text: Dear Mum and Dad, It’s the second day in China for Grandpa and me. I had a good time yesterday.
content.translation: 亲爱的爸爸妈妈：我和爷爷来中国已经第二天了。昨天我玩得很开心。

content.text: The high-speed train was a surprise! It was around 15 hours from Beijing to Xi’an about 30 years ago. Grandpa still remembers that. He had a long journey then.
content.translation: 高铁是一个惊喜！大约30年前，从北京到西安要花大约15个小时。爷爷还记得那件事，那时他有一段很长的旅程。

content.text: But now it takes only a little over four hours. We left Beijing in the morning and got to Xi’an in time for lunch.
content.translation: 但现在只需要四个多小时。我们早上离开北京，赶上了西安的午饭。

content.text: The “Chinese hamburger” tasted very good! Grandpa said, “It’s still the same taste!”
content.translation: “中国汉堡”尝起来非常好！爷爷说：“味道还是一样的！”

content.text: Xi’an also surprised me. It was an old city in Grandpa’s photos. But now it’s very different.
content.translation: 西安也让我很惊讶。在爷爷的照片里，它是一座古老的城市。但现在它非常不同了。

content.text: We are going to Chengdu tomorrow, also by the high-speed train. I can’t wait! With love, David
content.translation: 我们明天还要坐高铁去成都。我等不及了！爱你们的，戴维

content.text: In the Daliang Mountains, tall green trees grow. Birds sing all around. But about 40 years ago, it was very different there.
content.translation: 在大亮山，高大的绿树生长着，鸟儿在四周歌唱。但大约40年前，那里完全不是这样。

content.text: It changed because of Yang Shanzhou. In 1988, at the age of 61, he gave up a good life in the city.
content.translation: 这种变化是因为杨善洲。1988年，61岁的他放弃了城市里的美好生活。

content.text: I want to do something for my hometown.
content.translation: 我想为我的家乡做点什么。

content.text: He moved to the mountains and worked hard to make them green. Life was very hard, but he never gave up.
content.translation: 他搬到山里，努力让荒山变绿。生活很艰难，但他从未放弃。

content.text: He broke his left leg at the age of 72. But he was back to work after only half a year.
content.translation: 他72岁时摔断了左腿。但仅仅半年后，他就回去工作了。

content.text: After 22 years, the Daliang Mountains became a green world, with over 10 million trees.
content.translation: 22年后，大亮山变成了一个绿色的世界，有一千多万棵树。

content.text: By planting trees, Yang Shanzhou also planted hope. His hard work gave people a brighter and greener life.
content.translation: 通过种树，杨善洲也种下了希望。他的辛勤付出给了人们更光明、更绿色的生活。
